complete_identity_and_edge_audit.accepted_identity_capture: All five fields are captured only on event_accept at the active edge.
complete_identity_and_edge_audit.exact_linger_semantics: While event_valid remains sampled high with all five fields equal to the accepted identity, grace remains non-faulting, non-ready and non-accepting.
complete_identity_and_edge_audit.mutation_semantics_after_last: Because held_valid is released by an accepted last event, any one-field mutation breaks grace and has no live held-key identity; illegal_request and output quarantine assert combinationally before the next edge, then request_fault becomes sticky at the edge.
complete_identity_and_edge_audit.nonlast_semantics: An exact non-last linger is suppressed by grace; a changed legal descriptor with the same live source/block is intentionally eligible as the next event rather than being treated as a grace mutation fault.
complete_identity_and_edge_audit.between_edge_low_high_semantics: A valid low-high excursion wholly between active edges is synchronously unobserved; if the exact identity is restored before the next edge it remains the accepted request grace.
complete_identity_and_edge_audit.older_output_semantics: protocol_error masks the registered output in the same cycle and prevents output_valid_q retirement, including when output_ready rises with the illegal request.

conditional_performance_boundary.interpretation: frozen M104 r2 analytical conditional service-token work ratio only

dc_admission.admission_scope: Create and run an exact-SHA-pinned M104-only TSMC28 ideal-clock ZeroWireload common-period DC experiment for the reviewed RTL and one-entry production filelist.
requirements_for_launch: pin RTL SHA 7ea7978f431e917ee1a7835b8474af59e8f294587b1f115441388de8fb9c1ec5 and logic-only filelist SHA 4507f6af3f41cae8c1c26f6779f3c33803d30e03dcbaeef36348ee905f99fd36
create and pin the M104 SDC, setup and hold DBs, clock period, I/O delays, uncertainty, load, fanout, compile recipe and Synopsys tool version

report cell area, sequential area and FF count, setup and hold, all constraint violations and unmapped cells

findings.finding: The sealed suite and independent witness are bounded directed tests, not formal exhaustion or actual-record replay of the frozen event population.
findings.impact: Functional edge admission is bounded; no scheduled-runtime or workload-wide correctness claim follows.

findings.finding: Descriptor transpose, SRAM response, destination accumulator, full schedule and DMA remain port cuts, and the module has zero macros.
findings.impact: Module-only logic DC cannot establish macro-inclusive, equal-area, energy or end-to-end throughput.

findings.finding: The production-only filelist is clean but is not pinned by the r3 contract/sealed input manifest, and no M104-specific SDC or exact DC runner is present.
findings.impact: This review admits the DC next gate only; the DC launch must seal filelist, RTL, SDC, libraries and recipe before results are citable.

findings.finding: Same-cycle fail-closed behavior creates a combinational path from request identity comparison through protocol_error to output_valid/output_accept masking.
findings.impact: The safety behavior is functionally correct, but STA must prove this path at the target interface timing and integration must keep requests synchronous.

findings.finding: An exact accepted request remains in grace indefinitely while sampled valid and identity remain unchanged; this prevents double accept but supplies no timeout or liveness guarantee.
The between-edge low-high witness establishes synchronous digital observation only, not analog timing, CDC or metastability behavior.
The production SVA checks a current grace match but does not separately cover non-last exact linger or all five post-last identity mutations; this independent review supplies directed evidence only.
findings.suggested_action: Promote the independent edge and mutation properties into the production regression before future RTL edits.

findings.finding: Fault and quarantine cover matches include multiple occupied cycles per attack and must not be interpreted as independent attack counts.
The 2.6679769126038075x value is the unchanged M104 r2 conditional same-clock service-token ratio, not a scheduled-cycle, physical, equal-area, system or headline speedup.
